title: Tip It In
lines: Tim and Sis sat at a pit.
Tim is at a tin. Tip it in, Tim!
The tin fit in the pit!
Sis is at a tin pan. Tip it, Sis!
Sis! The pan is at the pit.
Sit as Tim sat, Sis. Tip it in!
The pan is in the pit!
Tim and Sis pat and pat.

questions.ask: What did Tim tip into the pit?
questions.listenFor: A tin. Line two says it. If your child is stuck, put a finger on that line and let them read it again.
A tin pan. Line four says it. A short answer is a fine answer here.

questions.ask: Sis missed the first time. What do you think helped her get it in? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any thoughtful answer counts. You are listening for a reason, such as she sat where Tim sat, or she tried again.
